'''Shuttle 2743''' was a [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttle]] that was tasked with transporting the Imperial [[Cloning|clone]] [[engineer]] [[Penn Pershing]] in [[9 ABY]].<ref name="Date">{{MandoDate|16}}</ref> After being disabled by ''[[Slave I]]''{{'s}} [[ion cannon]]s, the shuttle was taken over by [[Din Djarin]] and [[Marshal]] [[Carasynthia Dune|Cara Dune]]. The shuttle was subsequently used as part of the plan to [[Second rescue of Grogu|rescue]] [[Din Grogu|Grogu]] from [[Moff]] [[Gideon]]'s forces. After pretending to be under attack by ''Slave I'', the shuttle crash-landed into the launch tube of [[Gideon's light cruiser]]. Afterwards, Cara Dune, [[Bo-Katan Kryze]], [[Koska Reeves]], and [[Fennec Shand]] assaulted the hangar, with Din Djarin not far behind.

{{Ship-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Shuttle 2743 first appeared in "[[Chapter 16: The Rescue]]" of [[Jon Favreau]]'s [[2019]] [[Disney+]] television series ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]'', directed by [[Peyton Reed]]<ref name="Chapter 16" /> and released on [[December 18]], [[2020]].<ref name="D23">{{D23|url=everything-new-you-can-stream-on-disney-in-december-2020|text=Everything New You Can Stream on Disney+ in December 2020}}</ref>
